headline: Paraguay's rising Itaipu energy consumption threatens Brazil prices
summary: An increase in Paraguay's consumption of Itaipu hydroelectric energy is expected to pressure prices in Brazil and boost thermal power generation during evening peaks.
why: Cross-border energy dynamics and resource sharing impact regional electricity pricing and favor thermal generation providers during peak demand.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Higher energy consumption from Itaipu puts upward pressure on Brazilian electricity prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reduced availability of hydroelectric power from shared assets like Itaipu forces reliance on higher-cost thermal generation, driving up regional electricity prices.
